title: The four seasons
examples: What clothes do we wear in the summer?
Does the weather change in each season?
What happens to the trees in autumn?

explain.say: Today you will learn about the four seasons. The seasons change in the same order every year.
Now look. This is Earth's tilt and the seasons in 3D. Can you see the Sun and the tilted axis? Tap any part to hear about it.
In spring, plants start to grow. Flowers open, and the days get warmer.
Summer is the warmest season. The days are long.
In autumn, leaves change colour when the weather gets cooler. They turn red, gold and brown.
Winter is the coldest season. Sometimes snow falls. You wear a warm coat.
When you see falling leaves in the park, it is autumn. The seasons keep changing.

faq.a: Spring comes after winter. Plants start to grow again.
asks: What season follows the cold time?

faq.q: Do the seasons happen in a certain order?
faq.a: Yes. Spring, then summer, then autumn, then winter. Then spring comes again.
asks: Does it always go spring to summer?
Can you name the seasons in order?

faq.q: What clothes do we wear in the summer?
faq.a: In summer, you wear light clothes, like shorts and t-shirts. A sun hat helps too.
asks: Should I wear heavy coats in summer?
What is good clothing for summer?

faq.q: Why do leaves change colour in autumn?
faq.a: The weather gets cooler and the days get shorter. The trees get ready for winter.
asks: Why are leaves yellow in fall?
Do leaves just fall down in autumn?

faq.q: Is the weather always the same in one season?
faq.a: No. The weather can change from day to day. One day is sunny, and the next is rainy.
asks: Can the weather change in spring?
Is the weather always sunny in summer?
Does the weather change a lot?

facts: There are four main seasons throughout the year.
Spring brings new life and blooming flowers.
Summer is usually the warmest season.
Autumn is known for changing leaf colours.
Winter is the coldest season, sometimes with snow.

quiz.say: When do you wear a heavy coat and a scarf?
quiz.why: Winter is the coldest season, so you need warm clothes.

wrong.1: Summer is warm, so you wear light clothes.
wrong.2: Spring gets warmer, so you need fewer layers.

quiz.say: When is it warm enough for shorts and t-shirts?

wrong.0: Winter is cold, so you need warm clothes.
wrong.2: Autumn gets cooler, so you may need a jumper.

quiz.say: Leaves turn red and gold, then fall. Which season comes next?
quiz.why: After autumn comes winter, the coldest season.
